original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write a complete operation alphabet outside one named premise and price a baseline before searching identities.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: In R=F2[GL3(F2)], use all six coordinate-CNOT address labels Cij=I+Eij, exactly three scalar registers, arbitrary free scalar GL3(F2) mixing, and factors I+([g]+1)N for N=uv^T with v^Tu=1. For C=C01*C12*C20 (order 7, shortest coordinate-CNOT length 3), determine whether diag([C],[C],1) has a formal word of at most five paid factors; its direct word costs six.
scope_change_reason: The two-register GL3 version of this Singer target is covered by the recent all-six-coordinate-CNOT exact census for target-pair direct cost <=9 (PR #1567). This extends that target to one arbitrary dirty scalar role, keeping the full six-label alphabet so the changed hypothesis is the additional register. Related three-role work #1495 uses order-two swap targets; the S4 order-four result #1720 uses a different address group.
bottleneck_link: A five-call endpoint would show that one arbitrary dirty role and free register mixing can share paid bit operations for two noncommuting address targets. A six-call floor closes this exact route. The result remains a finite model, not an admitted supplier or a kappa change.
stop_rule: Enumerate the complete formal group algebra for every word through five paid factors using all 168 legal (six address labels, 28 rank-one idempotents) factors. Build the identity-side radius-two ball and stream all target-side words through radius three; stop after complete coverage or an exact five-call witness. Verify the direct six-call witness, all factor inverses, the complete 504-column regular action, and positive/negative controls. Do not expand to another register count or target in this cycle.
evidence: Exact formal GL3(F2) group-algebra replay enumerates all 168 paid factors. The identity-side radius-two shells are 1,168,21882 (22,051 states); the target-side raw word layers are 1,168,28224,4741632, totaling 4,770,025 endpoints. No endpoint lies in the identity ball, excluding every word through length five. The direct six-call witness is checked on all 504 faithful regular-action basis rows. All 168 inverse checks, identity and one-target join controls, wrong-order control, and six omitted-call controls pass. The exact minimum is six in the stated three-register full-coordinate-CNOT model; no supplier or new kappa is established.
author: Cinna Davis
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in task refinement, algebra, exact-search implementation, verification and writing. No independent human review or proof-assistant formalization is claimed.

open_questions.question: Can a second arbitrary dirty role lower this same two-target order-seven endpoint in the full six-label model?
open_questions.why_it_matters: That would test whether a second surplus scalar role can create sharing unavailable with one dirty role, under the same address target and operation alphabet.
open_questions.first_step: Pin the same target in exactly four scalar registers, derive the six-call direct witness and favorable lower-cost threshold, then estimate the exact 2+3 meet before implementing it.
open_questions.blocked_by: There are 120 rank-one idempotents and 720 one-call factors at four roles; the target-side search is much larger and may not meet the contribution budget.
